page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text; marginal notes in the left margin (small, partly illegible) and a few in the right margin; running head at top; page number top right; signature/catchword line at foot "P 4" and "Bibl." style marks at the bottom right.

main_text.p: & Tardiorem, sed nullo eventu, ut in Macedo- niam deesset, morte.

In MACEDONIA fuccessit Alexandro Perdiccas, & duo, quorum primus egit. Athe- niensibus Eleutherorum auxiliaribus, ìa-tenlus, Eludeiensis & Potidaeosin partes Peloponne- siorum pertraxit, ac destructis urbibus, incolas Olynthum migrare coegit, & Stalcem Thraeciae Bottiaeorum in Macedoniam reduxere voluit, quod quidem communitatis ad pacem adyect.
In BOEOTIA fuere fuc-cessive quattuor Thebanorum Antisa- ter & Scirtae.

Tubulo Artaxerxes magni floruisse vir. Hemmannobe, qui primus terram globosam & in Lacte. 9. medio beatae deus, & Heurbanus duo legit, pulsa... Hemyrcas Alterata, adeo ... sia, ut & liquidam incoluerit, rerum primordia, atomos & inane, mundo quaedam infinito, ex incurfu imagines mundi cernere, omnia excessisse quaedam deducere, Hemyrbat, & rationem juvandi mortales humanos profecto scientiae suis. Empedocles, qui solem ignem magnam mollam, ... longitudinem habere dixit, non quod vivi & movere, edendum putabat, & Ephoricos primus novit ab Aristoteles reddebant, ... qui Italiam Empedocles primus inflixit. Heraclitus, ... Marcus Macedoniae Servator, Thessalorum, & Thrieris dictus, quod venerantur ... malma. ... Haec ex Euboea & Illyride profecto valitudine ... ne sumuentur ... cubiculo ... Domesticis, ... Phoenicis ... caesar, ... ... Athenas.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin are largely illegible due to damage and show-through; the Greek and Latin marginal references are not reliably readable. Several passages are uncertain and the transcription of the heavily damaged lines is approximate. The bottom-right faint marks are a digitiser's stamp and are omitted.
